Proposal 7 installed the combined build b6868caa...d45b (raw 22f68be5...0039), the last one-canister release, which v0.3.8 lacked the freeze and export of; its first execution failed with umobs out of cycles (8.2G short of the install), the operator deposited 1T and the retry (governor.sh execute 7) installed it; its ic-git#canister publish failed on eth_feeHistory consensus (SysTransient, at the safe head), so no record names that module, which ran for about an hour. Then the freeze, the copy to the git canister (9 pages, 1,999 records, 8,455,212 bytes, digest 062496c6...6ee4 on both sides), and proposal 8 installed this module, the authority build, over the same state; its publish went through: ic-git#canister (commit 5c5c88e, this module hash) in Sepolia tx 0x4d4a72f3d8f5766408fdbb8d458ddb62a87e3fba6bb303ad60b21d7897ac4597, block 12148567. set_git_canister named 34koz-jyaaa-aaaab-ahejq-cai; every mirror was taken (get_mirrors_pending empty), no top-up was due (the git canister above the 1T floor); the git canister thawed. Afterwards umobs answers /site/... with a 308 to the git canister, the loader's and ic-vote's sites verify there, and the git-side records stay in umobs' stable memory, unread, for the rollback window. Gated by tools/e2e-local.sh with BASE_REF=v0.3.8: 276 checks on 5c5c88e, the upgrade from v0.3.8 and steps 16.1 to 16.6 included.
